newsitem.title: USA: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearbys down on soft basis.
newsitem.headline: KCBT wheat ends mixed, nearbys down on soft basis.

text.p: KCBT hard red winter wheat futures ended mixed, with nearbys lower on softness in cash basis bids, traders said.

The lower tone to the market came despite optimistic export news. USDA said Friday that wheat exports during the week ended Nov. 7 totaled 474.9 million tonnes, above trade expectations for 300,000 to 350,000 tonnes.

"Prices have rallied enough in the past week to the point that we've shaken some wheat free, and that's caused basis bids to drop. Today we had a four-cent demise in Kansas City spot basis," a trader said.
Softer basis bids took their toll on the December/March spread. Cargill reportedly was bidding for the spread at 29-1/2 cents early, but it narrowed throughout the day and was bid at 26 cents late.
KCBT wheat closed six cents per bushel lower to 1-1/2 cents higher, with Dec down six cents at $4.26-1/2.
Traders said Prudential sold one million March bushels and also bear-spread 700,000 March/Dec at 28-1/2 to 29-1/2 cents. Continental bull-spread 700,000 Dec/March at 29 to 29-1/2 cents.
